'''CZ-X-5438-A''' was an experiment run by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in an attempt to create synthetic [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]. The experiment's results were ultimately found to be not as effective as regular kolto when used to heal subjects of the wounds they sustained in other Czerka experiments.
